title: AuthGuard: bot defence for the ILIAS account-registration form
description:
ILIAS plugin that rejects automated submissions of the self-registration form. It generates a CAPTCHA image on the ILIAS server itself, contacts no third-party service, and no visitor data leaves the installation. Alongside the image it adds checks that ask a legitimate visitor for nothing: each code is single-use, image regeneration is throttled per session, and a submission arriving less than two seconds after the form was displayed is refused.

ILIAS core shipped a CAPTCHA on the self-registration form up to ILIAS 7 and removed it in ILIAS 8 on the grounds that it no longer kept bots out. This plugin restores the protection as a user-interface hook plugin, without any change to the ILIAS core.

This release offers an image-only challenge and therefore does not meet WCAG 2.1 success criterion 1.1.1; installations subject to EN 301 549 should provide an alternative registration route. Development is directed at checks that ask the visitor for nothing rather than at a harder puzzle.

For ILIAS 9 (9.0 and later 9.x), PHP 8.1 or 8.2.
